These two are ready to SETTLE things at  #HalloweenHavoc 😈

@ZariaWWE_ | @izzi_wwe https://t.co/mYd5rIj3Ks

transcript.text: Sorry, I knew your mask would slip eventually. I just had no idea what happened this quickly.
Last week, you offer up a North American title match? Because you would rather risk losing everything than face what you're hiding?
I was right about you all along. All you know how to do is hide. You hid behind a saxophone to try to escape your enemies.
You hid behind a pink dress and blonde wig, thinking now to make you popular and fit, and when that didn't work,
you try to become this big, bad monster in a leather jacket with red hair and face paint, thinking that somehow that would fix the broken girl you are inside.
You thought fighting everyone around you would somehow make you untouchable.
Until you came to NXT, and you made a friend, and she broke down every single one of those walls you spent so long putting up.
And now you're doing the same thing again. You're hiding behind the North American Championship, a championship I once held and will hold again when the time is right.
The Halloween habit? I'm gonna force you to face all the demons you spent your whole life running from.
The judgment. The loneliness. The insecurities. And when all those demons try to tear you apart from the inside out, I'll be there to take the only thing you have left to hide behind.
And that just is what it is.
